creator: Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5) worker session tien-nghich-2d-28, 2026-11-22
method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, template custom, 8 views, 40-colour palette, seed 11) then animate_character v3 per direction (frames stored at 40 px, centred on the 32 px manifest canvas, no scaling). v3 needs >=4 frames, so the 3-frame idle and telegraph clips use frame_select of 4 generated frames. Four facings are separate generations; nothing mirrored.
prompt: Shard mole, a small chibi stone-quarry burrowing mole: round plump body of rough grey-brown rock with a large head, a long pink-white snout, tiny dark eyes, big bronze digging claws on both front paws, a crown of jagged glowing cyan crystal shards growing on its back and head. Stocky, low, readable silhouette. Front-facing 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

idle.action_description: sits low and sniffs, snout twitching, the cyan crystal shards on its back glinting slightly, claws resting in front

direction_prompts.south: seen from the front, sits low and sniffs, snout twitching, crystals glint
direction_prompts.west: seen from the left side, sits low and sniffs toward the left, snout twitching, crystals glint
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, sits low, the crystal shards on its back glint
direction_prompts.east: seen from the right side, sits low and sniffs toward the right, snout twitching, crystals glint

walk.action_description: waddles forward on short legs in a quick shuffling trot, snout low, the cyan crystal shards on its back bouncing

direction_prompts.south: seen from the front, waddles toward the viewer, snout low, crystals bouncing
direction_prompts.west: seen from the left side, waddles to the left, snout low, crystals bouncing
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, waddles away from the viewer, crystals bouncing
direction_prompts.east: seen from the right side, waddles to the right, snout low, crystals bouncing

telegraph.action_description: rears up and raises both bronze digging claws high, the cyan crystal shards on its back flaring bright, winding up for a heavy swing

direction_prompts.south: seen from the front, rears up and raises both claws high, crystals flaring bright, winding up for a swing
direction_prompts.west: seen from the left side, rears up and raises the claws high behind it, crystals flaring, winding up to swing left
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, rears up, the crystal shards on its back flare bright
direction_prompts.east: seen from the right side, rears up and raises the claws high behind it, crystals flaring, winding up to swing right

strike.action_description: slams both bronze digging claws down hard in front of it in a heavy swipe, crystals flashing, then recovers

direction_prompts.south: seen from the front, slams both claws down toward the viewer in a heavy swipe, then recovers
direction_prompts.west: seen from the left side, slams the claws down to the left in a heavy swipe, then recovers
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, slams the claws down away from the viewer, then recovers
direction_prompts.east: seen from the right side, slams the claws down to the right in a heavy swipe, then recovers

attempts.what: create character + idle, walk, telegraph, strike for 4 directions (idle/telegraph generated at 4 frames, 3 selected); clips queued in partial batches into the same groups because job slots are shared
attempts.result: accepted for integration, art awaits owner review

one strike frame in each side view shows a pale white claw or snout highlight that looks like a stray blob
